claims.statement: The assignment edit step uses the pencil/settings control for the intended assignment. Navigation does not establish edit authority, changed settings or a completed assignment update.

A group assignment is collaborative coursework for student groups in Classroom. This definition does not establish team membership, repository permissions, contribution equity or actual learning outcomes.
An assignment deadline is optional and chosen through the deadline date picker. The fragment does not establish timezone, enforcement, late-work handling or a mandatory deadline for all assignments.
The Add an editor menu selects the intended assignment IDE. This contextual choice does not demonstrate provisioning, availability, cost approval, execution safety or mandatory hosted development.

The starter-code template is chosen by searching and selecting a template repository. Selection does not prove pedagogical suitability, safe executable content, license clearance or automatic review of that repository; source code remains untrusted until separately reviewed.

Assignment repository visibility is explicitly selected, and granting students repository admin access is optional. Neither public visibility nor elevated student permissions are mandated; configuration guidance does not authorize access changes or verify resulting permissions.
